jobs.description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

jobs.description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. You're equally comfortable thinking about messaging and positioning as you are reading a CPL report.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants ownership across the funnel and the chance to directly influence pipeline at a fast-growing vertical SaaS company. If you like wearing multiple hats, learning a niche industry deeply, and seeing your work drive measurable results, you'll fit right in.

Duties & Responsibilities include:

Product & content marketing

  • Translate product features and capabilities into clear, benefit-driven messaging that resonates with millwork and cabinetry business owners.
  • Write and produce marketing content across formats â landing pages, web copy, emails, case studies, one-pagers, ad copy, and campaign assets.
  • Partner with product and sales to keep positioning sharp and messaging consistent across the buyer journey.

Web production (WordPress)

  • Build, edit, and publish web pages in WordPress â from landing pages to product and resource pages â with an eye for layout, conversion, and on-page experience.
  • Maintain and improve the website over time: updating content, fixing issues, A/B testing, and ensuring pages stay fast, on-brand, and conversion-ready.

Paid social & paid search

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across search (Google Ads) and social (LinkedIn, Meta, and others as relevant).
  • Own day-to-day campaign management: audiences, creative, budgets, bidding, and ongoing testing to improve cost-per-lead and ROAS.
  • Report on performance and translate results into clear next steps.

Demand generation

  • Support full-funnel demand gen programs that drive leads and pipeline â across email, webinars, events, content syndication, and nurture.
  • Help build and execute integrated campaigns from concept through measurement.
  • Track and report on funnel metrics, contributing to a continuous test-and-learn culture.

Knowledge and Preferred Qualifications:

  • Attention to detail sets you apart. Youâll be working across multiple projects at once, and get to be responsible for delivering them with a high standard of quality
  • Youâre organized, efficient and deadline driven

  • Comfort with analytics tools (GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio) and ad platforms' native reporting.

Qualifications

Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.
  • Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.
  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

  • Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly.

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

What Weâre Looking ForEssential experience

  • 1-3 yearsâ experience in online customer support, ideally for a B2B SaaS or similar software company
  • Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to explain things clearly, simply and warmly
  • A calm, patient and empathetic approach to helping customers
  • Good attention to detail, especially when dealing with billing, account or technical questions
  • A practical approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Confidence learning new software tools and understanding how web-based products work

  • The ability to work independently in a remote team and manage your time well

jobs.description:
About us

SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings.

Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life.

About the role

The Product Business Analyst bridges the gap between business needs and engineering delivery, turning ideas, requests and requirements into clear, actionable work.

By bringing clarity to ambiguity, connecting work across Product and Platform Engineering and making sure teams have the information they need, the role helps reduce rework, improve delivery and build better software for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery and shaping

  • Work with stakeholders to explore ideas, requests and feedback, clarifying the underlying problem, business need and intended outcome before work is defined

  • Explore the reasons behind requests before work is defined, ensuring relevant context and requirements are understood.

  • Challenge assumptions constructively, identify gaps and surface conflicting needs or unanswered questions early.

  • Identify and engage the right stakeholders to provide the information and decisions needed to shape clear requirements.

Turning needs into actionable work

  • Translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering teams sufficient context to progress work effectively.

  • Break down defined or moderately complex initiatives into clear, deliverable increments, working with Product and Engineering colleagues and seeking support on more complex work where needed,

  • Maintain accurate requirements and supporting context in Jira, including agreed scope, relevant decisions and material changes.

  • Keep requirements current as understanding or scope develops, working with relevant Product, Engineering and project colleagues to capture what has changed and why.

Question resolution during delivery

  • Remain closely involved during delivery as a point of contact for requirements-related questions and clarification.

  • Investigate ambiguity, work with the right stakeholders to resolve requirements questions and escalate more complex issues where needed so engineering teams can continue with clear direction.

  • Participate in refinement and planning discussions where business analysis input is needed to clarify scope, requirements or agreed decisions.

  • Maintain traceability from the original business need through agreed requirements and material changes to what is ultimately delivered.

Integrating product and platform work

  • Maintain awareness of relevant work across Product and Platform Engineering and identify dependencies, overlaps or potential impacts between teams.

  • Help shape requirements where product and platform changes need to work together, ensuring relevant dependencies and constraints are understood.

  • Flag where teams may be addressing the same problem, where proposed changes could conflict, or where work in one area creates an impact elsewhere.

  • Support effective handovers and cross-team working by ensuring teams have the requirements context and documentation they need.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Build constructive working relationships across Product, Engineering, QA, customer-facing teams and the wider business.

  • Translate engineering questions and constraints into clear language for business stakeholders.

  • Translate business needs and agreed intent into precise, actionable requirements for engineering teams.

  • Help stakeholders understand what has been agreed from a requirements perspective, what remains unresolved and where further input or decisions are needed.

Essential experience

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst, or in a closely related analysis role, within software delivery.

  • Strong requirements elicitation and analysis skills, including the ability to work from incomplete or ambiguous information, identify gaps and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, structured requirements, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and supporting documentation.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels and follow through to obtain the information needed to resolve ambiguity.

  • Experience working with Jira and Agile software delivery teams.

  • Experience working across multiple teams where shared dependencies, changes or overlapping requirements need to be understood clearly.

  • A good level of technical understanding, enabling effective conversations with engineers about scope, constraints, dependencies and trade-offs.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with good attention to detail and the ability to maintain clarity as requirements evolve.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - London
jobs.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

You own the commercial relationship for Siena's highest-value brands: renewals, expansion, executive trust, and knowing your accounts better than anyone. A deployment strategist owns product outcomes for the same accounts, and together you're the Siena pod.

You're accountable for net dollar retention, expansion quota attainment, and executive relationship health across your book. You own our Growth and Strategic segment accounts, not the full customer book, working at the intersection of customer, sales, and your deployment strategist. Expect moderate travel for in-person workshops, account visits, and QBRs.

What You'll Do

  • Own the commercial relationship end to end for a portfolio of Growth and Strategic accounts, from post-onboarding through long-term growth: build concrete account plans, track impact with data, and hold customers and internal teams accountable when progress stalls

  • Map every account and build executive trust: maintain a living stakeholder map, build relationships with decision-makers beyond day-to-day contacts, and own the executive cadence so leadership sees Siena's value before renewal conversations start

  • Drive commercial outcomes: own renewal negotiations, independently identify and close expansion opportunities, and quantify customer ROI in cost savings, efficiency, or revenue impact

  • Bring product depth to the relationship: understand how Siena's agents work together, explain capabilities confidently, and guide customers on the best strategic use cases

  • Lead cross-functional execution: turn vague customer problems into clear problem statements and execution plans, partnering with other teams as needed

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

  • 3+ years in account management with technical, complex software, including at least one independently negotiated $100k+ deal

  • Startup background: comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, wearing many hats

  • E-commerce or CX industry experience: customers respond better to AMs who speak their language

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • Hands-on AI experience: you've built an agent, automated a workflow, or created a tool, not just used ChatGPT for email

  • Enterprise experience: managed complex orgs, sold to multiple stakeholders

  • Close collaboration experience with product and engineering teams

  • Self-directed: brings solutions, not just problems

  • Balances empathy with commercial impact, willing to challenge the status quo when it blocks results

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

  • Experience at a native AI technology company

  • Comfort with API integrations, conversation flow design, and business intelligence tools

Not a Fit If:

  • You want a fixed playbook and clear SOPs before you start

  • You'd rather support the commercial conversation than own it

  • You need close oversight rather than working independently with your deployment strategist as your main partner

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How we hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Trainee Accountant
jobs.description:
Zeeco fosters a robust work environment where employees, from engineering teams to support groups, benefit from a strong culture, trained leadership, and opportunities for growth. Zeeco collaborates with the biggest names in the industry, enabling individuals to broaden their skills alongside teams of subject matter experts. 

Build your finance career with Zeeco

Are you looking to start or develop your career in accounting and finance? This is a great opportunity to join Zeeco Europe as a Trainee Accountant / Accounts Assistant, gaining hands-on experience across a busy finance function while developing your professional skills.

Working as part of our Accounts team, you’ll support the day-to-day processing and cost control activities of the department, with a particular focus on purchase and sales ledger. You’ll also have the opportunity to support the Financial Controller and Finance Manager on a variety of projects and wider finance activities.

For someone looking to develop professionally, there is also the opportunity to complete AAT studies (over three years), either through an apprenticeship or self-study route.

Key responsibilities:

Purchase Ledger

  • Processing supplier invoices against purchase orders.
  • Coding and processing non-PO invoices, ensuring the appropriate approvals are obtained.
  • Maintaining accurate supplier information.
  • Resolving invoice queries with suppliers and internal departments.
  • Posting and allocating Direct Debit payments.
  • Following up advance payments and obtaining the relevant tax invoices.
  • Reconciling supplier statements and accounts.

Sales Ledger

  • Posting daily cash receipts.
  • Allocating customer payments against the appropriate invoices.
  • Ensuring customer accounts are accurately reconciled.
  • Responding to customer audit requests.

Wider Finance Support

  • Reconciling corporate credit card statements.
  • Coding and processing employee expenses.
  • Processing weekly timesheets accurately and on time.
  • Supporting annual audit requirements.
  • Assisting with the maintenance and audit of the fixed asset schedule.
  • Supporting perpetual inventory counts and the annual stock take.
  • Providing additional support to the Finance Manager and Financial Controller as required.
  • Providing cover for other members of the Accounts team during periods of absence.
  • Getting involved in ad hoc projects and activities across the finance department.

What we’re looking for

You don’t necessarily need extensive finance experience. We’re looking for someone who is motivated to learn, organised and keen to develop a career in accounting.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • GCSE Grade C/4 or above in Maths and English.
  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and particularly Excel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organisation and time-management skills.
  • The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a dependable approach to your work.
  • Good problem-solving skills and the confidence to use your initiative.
  • A flexible approach and the ability to adapt when priorities change.
  • A positive, collaborative attitude and enjoy working as part of a team.
  • A commitment to learning and continuous improvement.
  • A willingness to undertake AAT studies (over three years), either through an apprenticeship or self-study.

Previous experience within a finance department or using Sage 200 would be advantageous, but isn’t essential.

Why Zeeco?

This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical finance experience while developing your accounting knowledge and professional qualifications. You’ll work alongside an experienced finance team, gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting activities rather than being limited to one area.

If you’re organised, enthusiastic and ready to take the next step in your finance career, we’d love to hear from you.

Working at Zeeco means being part of a people-centric culture and environment built on mutual respect, personal encouragement, professional integrity, and limitless opportunity. Join Zeeco and embark on a fulfilling journey where innovation, collaboration, and personal and professional growth converge.

Bei unserem Kunden wird im Rahmen der Weiterentwicklung einer Cloud an Konzeption und dem Aufbau eines zentralen Repositories für Software gearbeitet. In der Anlage erfolgt ein Aufbau zunächst für den OpenSouce Cloud Stack, es sollen aber Konzepte und Proof of Conzepts für any Software on any Platform entwickelt werden. Für diese Software Produkte müssen Funktions- und Lasttests in der Cloud konzipiert und erprobt werden.

Die Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Analyse funktionaler und nicht-funktionaler Anforderungen. Identifikation von technischen Rahmenbedingungen und Schnittstellen.

  • Entwurf von Systemkomponenten, Schnittstellen und Datenflüssen.

  • Analyse interner und externer Abhängigkeiten zwischen Modulen, Services und Drittsystemen.

  • Definition von Integrationsstrategien z. B. API-Gateways, Adapter, Service Mesh.

  • Recherche und Bewertung alternativer Technologien, Frameworks oder Produkte.

  • Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen z. B. Pro/Contra-Tabellen, Proof-of-Concepts.

  • Risikoanalyse bei Migration oder Einführung neuer Lösungen.

  • Erstellung eines Plans zur Containerisierung bestehender oder neuer Komponenten.

  • Bewertung von Eignung zur Containerisierung Statefulness, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcenverbrauch.

  • Definition von Vorgaben für Containerisierung.

  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation.

  • Architektur-Reviews, DevOps-Unterstützung

  • Sicherstellung von Performance, Skalierbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit.

  • Integration von Authentifizierung, Autorisierung und Verschlüsselung.

  • Umsetzung von Security-by-Design und Privacy-by-Design.

  • Technische Abstimmung mit Dev-Teams, Operations, Product Ownern und externen Partnern.

  • Präsentation und Verteidigung von Architekturentscheidungen vor Management oder Kunden.

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Kubernetes Anwendungen

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Analyse und Bewertung von Legacy Software für Migration in Cloud Environments

  • mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Anforderungsanalyse und Systementwurf von Air Gap Container Repositories

  • Product-Engineering: Erfahrung darin, Anforderungen aus Business- und Nutzer:innen-Perspektive einzuordnen, bevor sie technisch umgesetzt werden

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer in Production [Mid-Senior; F/M/D]
jobs.description:
Your mission

If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skills to food production technology, this is your chance to develop innovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, this is your chance to take the next step and take operational responsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing, purpose-driven startup.

Key responsibilities

  • Machinery Installation & Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment, perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conduct functional testing to ensure proper operation before production use.

  • Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes and equipment performance, identify improvements, and design modifications to increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance. Implement optimizations in the production environment.

  • Equipment Repair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complex issues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automation equipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime.

  • Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanical prototypes and  operational processes, validate design performance through testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on production feedback and food safety requirements.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, R&D and quality teams to optimize equipment performance and resolve complex production challenges. Communicate equipment status and maintenance needs to production planning and leadership.

  • Technical documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics, mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications.

  • Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurement activities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure project deliverables meet specifications.



Your profile

In this role, you'll be responsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developing mechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, and supporting the mechanical engineering needs of our production operations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work on everything from equipment design to production support.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineering experience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably with exposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automated systems.

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance, reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge of food industry applications preferred.

  • Technical Skills: Knowledge of manufacturing processes and production optimization techniques, familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshooting abilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions and diagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiency with CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing software systems.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience in root cause analysis and process troubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and develop longlasting cost effective engineering solutions.

  • Operational Agility: A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. 

  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional level in the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Why us?

Why you should apply now

  • Scaling Big: We’re at an exciting inflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scaling operations. Be part of something transformative and build it from the ground up.
  • Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and angels who share our vision and believe in our mission.
  • The Time is Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away from animal-based meat, fast!
A word on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

We embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared values and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, or marital status.

Workspace and culture

We’re building something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Our team thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power of face-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively. Currently, we spend most of our time together at our workplace in Berlin to nurture our team spirit and culture. As we grow over the next few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace, blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of our shared values and connection.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant (m/f/d) - Growth & Strategy
jobs.description:
The Role

This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work.
You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth.
There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market, initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows.What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage customer opportunities end-to-end, from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team.
  • Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets.
  • Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets.
  • Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network.
  • Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach, including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market.
  • As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities.


Your profile

  • You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation.
  • You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close.
  • You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit.
  • You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions.
  • You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value.
  • You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities.
  • You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow.
  • You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time.
  • You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently.
  • You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events, typically up to five days per month.
  • A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us.


Why us?

  • You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done.
  • You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work, with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events.
  • The role comes with a strong fixed salary, with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow.
  • You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget, home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats.
  • You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like.
  • Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

jobs.title: Business Development / Mba Co-Founder (F/M/D) Role At Startup Chillquanta
jobs.description:
**CHILLQUANTA
**Bochum, Germany (Ruhr University Bochum) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Quantum & Semiconductor Metrology

**About ChillQuanta
**ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Target market: quantum and semiconductor chip makers.

**The opportunity
**Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.

Tasks

What you will own

**Company build-up & strategy
**- Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised.

**Commercialization
**- Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team.
- Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers and design partners.
Business operations
- Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have.

Requirements

**What you bring
**

**Core experience
**- Business development or MBA-level commercial experience, ideally with deep-tech, scientific instrumentation, or semiconductor/quantum industry exposure.
- Comfort making a licensing-vs-startup call and building a go-to-market plan from a lab-stage prototype.

**Especially valuable
**- Existing network in quantum technology, semiconductor metrology, or scientific instrumentation.
- Fundraising experience for deep-tech ventures (grants and/or investors).
- ChillQuanta is separately seeking an AI/ML co-founder to build wafer-scale AI prediction — relevant ML/software experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join ChillQuanta
- A validated lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, with an Invention Disclosure already accepted by RUB and a manuscript heading to Physical Review Letters.
- A genuinely novel technique (patent filing in progress) addressing a real gap in photonic-qubit inspection for the fast-growing quantum and semiconductor chip markets.
- Ground-floor business co-founder equity alongside a strong physics/chemistry founding team.

ChillQuanta welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

jobs.title: Account Receivable Specialist
jobs.description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About the Role

Cash flow is the fuel behind every hire we make and every GPU we spin up — and right now, that process runs on scrappy startup instincts more than scalable systems. We're hiring an AR Specialist to change that: someone who can take full ownership of collections, chase down what's owed without losing the relationship, and build the reporting and processes that let Finance actually see around corners. You'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success, which means your work is never just about invoices — it's about making sure the whole revenue engine runs cleanly as we scale. If you get real satisfaction from replacing chaos with a system that just works, this role was built for you.

What You'll Do

Own Accounts Receivable, start to finish

  • Run the full Account Receivable lifecycle — invoicing, payment tracking, account reconciliation

  • Watch aging reports like a hawk and chase down outstanding invoices before they become a problem

  • Keep customer account records clean and resolve billing discrepancies fast

  • Support month-end close for everything AR and cash application related

Drive collections and cash flow

  • Design and execute collection strategies that shrink DSO and speed up cash collections

  • Build real relationships with customer AP teams — the kind that get payment delays resolved with a phone call, not an escalation

  • Know when to escalate high-risk or delinquent accounts, and do it without burning the relationship

  • Spot payment risk early by reading the trends before they become write-offs

Build the systems, not just run them

  • Use collections tools to automate outreach and track performance — this isn't a spreadsheets-forever role

  • Partner with Finance leadership to level up AR processes, reporting, and controls

  • Work with Sales to make sure billing is accurate from the first invoice

  • Help build the scalable AR playbook a high-growth startup actually needs

Report on what matters

  • Put together weekly AR aging and collections reports for leadership

  • Track DSO, collection effectiveness, and overdue balances like they're your own scorecard

  • Support audits and keep documentation clean for compliance

Qualifications/Nice to haves:

  • 3+ years in Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections

  • Comfortable in a SaaS, tech, or startup environment

  • Solid grasp of AR processes, collections strategy, and cash application

  • Experience with an ERP/accounting system

  • Strong communicator and negotiator — genuinely fine picking up the phone and calling a customer

  • Organized, detail-obsessed, and good at juggling deadlines when things move fast

  • Hands-on experience with Tesorio or similar AR automation/collections platforms

  • Experience supporting enterprise or B2B customers

  • Familiarity with SaaS billing models, contracts, and revenue operations

  • Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis and reporting

  • Track record working cross-functionally with Sales and Operations

What we offer at fal

  • Interesting and challenging work

  • A lot of learning and growth opportunities

  • We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

  • Regular team events and offsites

Compensation

  • $100,000 - $140,000 + equity + comprehensive benefits package

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - France
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level french speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.
