jobs.title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

jobs.title: Propulsion GSE Team Leader
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Propulsion Ground Support Equipment Team Leader, to lead the development, commissioning and operation of our engine test benches that we use to test our cryogenic engines and storable thrusters.

This is a key leadership role that requires technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a strong track record in managing complex engineering projects, and proven experience in leading and mentoring technical teams. The GSE Team Leader role for Liquid Propulsion Testing drives the end-to-end lifecycle – from initial concept and fluid/structural design to fabrication, commissioning, and operation – of critical ground infrastructure supporting liquid propellant rocket engine test campaigns.

As the GSE Team Leader, you will oversee the design, development and building of propulsion test facility. The primary objective is to develop and maintain robust, high-reliability test bench GSE that meets ambitious program cadences while ensuring absolute safety in hazardous operating environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the engineering development of new test facility GSE, including high-pressure gas distribution systems, propellant feed systems, electrical network, control and data acquisition system, mechanical structures, etc.

  • Translate test matrix requirements into hardware specifications, master P&IDs, and fluid system architectures

  • Manage a cross-functional team of mechanical, fluid, and instrumentation engineers and technicians

  • Direct resource allocation across multiple test benches, manage development schedules, and ensure alignment between propulsion design teams and facility operations

  • Oversee the structural fabrication, tube bending, welding, and mechanical assembly of GSE lines, panels, and thrust measurement structures

  • Lead high-pressure proof testing, leak checks, and system commissioning/decommissioning phases

  • Establish protocols for handling hazardous fluids (both cryogenic and storable propellants)

  • Enforce strict compliance with oxygen compatibility, system passivation, and precision cleanliness levels

  • Manage data acquisition and control systems (DAQ/DCS) engineers and technicians to integrate sensors (pressure transducers, thermocouples, flow meters) and remote-actuated valves into the GSE infrastructure for automated test sequences and redline monitoring

jobs.title: Managing Director - France
jobs.description:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

While we may not have an immediate opening in your geography or vertical, we maintain a high-touch pipeline of senior candidates aligned with our investment roadmap.

Candidates with the experience outlined above will be contacted for follow-up discussions.

  • Analyse von Logs und Fehlerbehebung im laufenden Betrieb (Kein Bereitschafts- oder 24/7-Dienst)

Erforderlich

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python oder einer vergleichbaren Backend-Sprache (z. B. Java, Kotlin, C# oder Go) sowie die Bereitschaft, produktiv mit Python zu arbeiten
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, Datenmodellierung, Linux/Ubuntu und Git
  • Solides Grundlagenwissen zu Machine Learning, generativer KI und Large Language Models
  • Erste praktische KI-Anwendungen, zum Beispiel aus Studium, Abschlussarbeit, eigenen Projekten oder dem beruflichen Kontext

jobs.description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Für unser Einkaufsteam suchen wir eine engagierte Einkaufspersönlichkeit mit Schwerpunkt Marketing. Du verantwortest das Tagesgeschäft in dieser Kategorie, unterstützt bei Bedarf vertretungsweise auch andere Einkaufsbereiche und arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team am Ausbau von Coupa.

Aufgaben

  • Du prüfst Angebote und verhandelst Produktions- und Kreativverträge, Buyouts sowie Nutzungsrechte (Darsteller,
    Voice-over, Musik, KI-Assets).
  • Du begleitest Pitches und RFPs für Kreation, Produktion und Tools – von der Longlist bis zur Vertragsunterschrift.
  • Du steuerst Media-Agentur-Pitches und -Verträge gemeinsam mit dem Media-Team: Vergütungsmodelle,
    Kickbacks, Makegoods, Audit-Rechte, Exit-Klauseln.
  • Du kaufst Tools und Lizenzen für das Marketing ein: Martech, Research, SaaS.
  • Du unterstützt vertretungsweise auch andere Einkaufsbereiche im Team, wenn es die Auslastung erfordert.
  • Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit den anderen Einkäufern am Ausbau von Coupa – insbesondere am Aufbau von
    Katalogen und Punchout-Anbindungen.
  • Du hältst die Prozesse sauber: Vertragsablage, Lieferantenbewertung, Savings-Reporting.

Qualifikationen

  • Einkaufserfahrung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Marketing- oder Media-Einkauf.
  • Idealerweise ein Studium im betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.
  • Sichere Verhandlungsführung auf Deutsch und Englisch. Weitere Sprachen unserer Märkte (ES, FR, IT, PL, NL)
    sind von Vorteil.
  • Vertragssicherheit bei Rahmenverträgen, Nutzungs- und Lizenzrechten sowie SLAs.
  • Erfahrung mit P2P-Systemen wie Coupa, idealerweise inkl. Katalogaufbau und Punchout.
  • Von Vorteil: Grundverständnis der Media-Welt (CPM, GRP, Kickbacks, Agentur-Vergütungsmodelle).
  • KI ist für dich kein Fremdwort – du setzt sie gerne und selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag ein, auch bei
    Rechtsfragen rund um KI-Content wie Kennzeichnungspflichten oder KI-Darsteller als Buyout-Alternative.
  • Gestaltungswille und Freude an Aufbauarbeit – du bringst dich aktiv in den Aufbau des Zentraleinkaufs ein, statt
    nur bestehende Prozesse zu verwalten.
  • Strukturierte, verlässliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick und sicheres, verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber internen und externen Stakeholdern.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Spaß an der Arbeit in einem technologisch geprägten Umfeld.
  • Gespür für den Spagat zwischen Kosten und KPIs auf der einen sowie Kreativität und Markenwirkung auf der
    anderen Seite.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (ESS / PV) - France (South)
jobs.description:
Your mission

Bonjour et bienvenue à Sungrow! We’re seeking a skilled Field Service Engineer to join our vibrant team in the south part of France.

In this role, you will become the primary point of contact for our valued customers, handling technical inquiries and resolving issues efficiently while ensuring the seamless operation of our cutting-edge solar energy products.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing on-site installation, maintenance, and upgrade activities.
  • Collaborating closely with project management teams during commissioning and site acceptance phases.
  • Ensuring compliance with operational procedures and all health & safety regulations.
  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation for current and future service contracts.


Your profile

All right, all right, that was intriguing, wasn't it? Now, in order to fit in this role and be happy for a long time, your ideal background should look a lot like this: 

  • You possess a degree in electrical engineering or have a strong electrician background, providing a solid foundation for technical expertise. 
  • Demonstrate fluency in both English and French (C1 level), enabling clear and effective communication with a diverse range of stakeholders. 
  • You are prepared for on-call duties, showcasing your commitment to timely support and problem resolution. 
  • A valid driving license and a willingness to travel extensively across France are essential for successful on-site interventions. 
  • Previous experience with battery storage solutions is a plus, enhancing your ability to service our diverse product portfolio. 
  • While not mandatory, skills in Chinese (Mandarin) would be beneficial for interacting with our international teams. 
  • A deep understanding of the European solar energy market and our range of products, including PV, ESS, and EV charging solutions, would be highly advantageous.


Why us?

At Sungrow, we are committed to becoming the global leader in power conversion technology, providing clean power worldwide. We are a dynamic company with over two decades of experience in the PV industry, running the largest R&D team in the sector. You will be joining a team that fosters career advancement, offers attractive compensation and benefits, and operates within an international working environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Director Business and Digital Product Development (m/w/d): win business and drive platform building
jobs.description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e. g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Roland Berger. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy to use). Developing it further takes people who understand what the entrepreneurs on our platform, the Vico Leads, need: they must be able to run their Vico end-to-end without overhead and with minimal effort.

We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

Our offer to you

As Director Business and Digital Product Development you combine three capabilities:

• Business development: you win new clients and business for our Vicos

• Digital product development: you turn user needs into requirements that our engineers turn into platform capabilities

• Entrepreneurial drive in building a hyper-scaling business: this is about continuously driving the perfection of our product, go-to-market, processes and tools

You join our go-to-market team and work closely with our platform building team. Your work directly affects how well thousands of freelance experts can run their own companies on our platform.

Tasks

Shape the market

• Position Vicoland with enterprise clients as the strategic alternative to traditional professional services models.

• Question established sourcing models and demonstrate why Vicos deliver better outcomes.

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to specific client contexts.

• Build thought leadership through events and LinkedIn presence.

Win and grow clients

• Develop and own a portfolio of enterprise clients and partners – from strategic outreach through close to long-term expansion.

• Win new business together with Vico Leads, and learn from every deal what the platform must do better.

Lead and enable Vico Leads

• Be the go-to person for Vico Leads on the platform: help them solve problems, and bring in engineering where needed.

• Supervise and coach Vico Leads in your client group – hold them accountable for delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Activate new Vico Leads and help them grow their own marketplace business on the platform.

Continuously define the platform and shape the company

• Translate the real problems, needs and workflows of Vico Leads into concrete requirements and feature requests for our engineering team.

• Prioritize features by impact on business and shape the platform roadmap.

• Follow each feature to release, check whether it works for Vico Leads, and drive our NPS.

• Bring market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insight into the organization and our product.

• Help define how we scale: processes, tools, talent, culture.

Requirements

• 5+ years in professional services (e. g. consulting, system integration, sales of complex products) or in a product-driven start-up or scale-up.

• Proven consultative selling capacity: you can win complex enterprise deals by advising, not pitching.

• Solid understanding of digital products: you like working with users and engineers alike and you can define requirements that engineers can make real.

• Thorough and pragmatic: you think problems through and deliver concrete results.

• Challenger mindset: you shape how clients and the market at large think about professional services sourcing and are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders.

• AI-affinity: you actively use AI tools and understand the strategic implications of agentic AI for professional services.

• Entrepreneurial energy – you are drawn to building markets, not administering existing ones. Own entrepreneurial experience is a strong plus.

• Strong academic background, fast career progression, proven commercial impact.

• Fluent in German and English (DACH is our home market, while we expand internationally).

• Network power: you have and build valuable relationships easily.

Benefits

• Attractive compensation with fixed salary, variable component tied to the commercial success of your Vicos, and company shares (ESOP in place).

• Entrepreneurial key position in an industry-transforming company with direct impact on company results, the market, and your personal growth.

• High degree of autonomy in how you develop your client portfolio, work with Vico Leads and shape the product.

• Fast-paced environment with a highly talented team of diverse backgrounds and top-notch qualifications.

• Flexibility in how and where you work – remote and/or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Barcelona, Berlin, Seville).

Ready to shape a market? Then let’s talk about your journey as Director Business and Digital Product Development.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $100B in annualized spend flows in and out of 50,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

 

About the Role

Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.

In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high-signal judgment calls throughout the day.

You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support. You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.

  • Diagnose across a broad product surface. Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.

  • Operate with an ownership mindset, managing escalations end-to-end. You take full accountability for every ticket you handle. When an issue crosses team boundaries — risk, engineering, product, partnerships — you route it correctly, follow up, and make sure the customer isn't left waiting. You'll work across Zendesk, internal tooling, and Slack-based escalation workflows.

  • Build and shape AI tools, not just use them. Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.

  • Ship improvements, not just flag them. When you notice a process gap, a missing SOP, or a knowledge base article that's sending associates down the wrong path, you don't just raise it — you have the autonomy to roll up your sleeves and fix it. Leverage AI to solve problems, build automations, and improve the systems around you. The best people in this role make the whole team better.

  • Communicate with precision and empathy. Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

What You Need

  • You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.

  • You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.

  • You're fast-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.

  • You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.

  • You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.

  • You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.

  • You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.

  • You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed-of-service metrics.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building workflows or automations using AI tools, not just prompting

  • Familiarity with accounting workflows (AP/AR, GL, reconciliation) or ERP integrations (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage)

  • Background in payments infrastructure (ACH, wire transfers, card networks)

  • Track record of working somewhere that shipped product fast and expected CX to keep up

Why be a CX Associates at Ramp

  • Cross-functional exposure from day one. You work directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams — not siloed into a support queue.

  • AI tools and unlimited access. Unlimited tokens, proprietary AI tools like Glass, and a culture that expects you to use them to move faster and build smarter.

  • Career growth that you own. Grow within CX, explore other functions internally, or carve out a path that doesn't exist yet. If you're invested, we're invested.

  • Culture that's different from a call center. Team events, in-person offsites, and a genuine commitment to building a team people want to be part of.

Read more about how Ramp thinks about AI and CX:

  • How Ramp Became an AI-First Company — Geoff Charles, CPO

  • Inside Glass: How Ramp Built a Proprietary AI Platform for CX — Seb Goddijn, AI Product Manager

  • AI-Powered Customer Experience at Ramp — Ben Levick, Head of CX / Ramp AI

What to know before you apply

  • Schedule & Shift Bidding - Please Read Carefully: This role is part of Ramp’s UK-based overnight coverage strategy. Team members will work a set 40-hour/week schedule designed to support customer needs outside US business hours. jobs.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is looking for a senior social media and communications leader who can turn deep technical substance into public narrative, executive voice and market momentum.

The right candidate is a high-agency B2B technology storyteller: technically curious, editorially sharp, deeply fluent in social media, and resourceful enough to build a steady pipeline of speaking opportunities, conference submissions, podcast pitches, panels, awards, and executive visibility moments.

You should be comfortable operating in complex technical markets AI infrastructure, GPUs, datacenters, developer platforms, enterprise software or similar categories. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to sit with technical leaders, understand what matters, find the angle, and translate it into language that is sharp, credible, and useful.

What You’ll Own

Social Media Strategy & Execution

You will own the company’s social presence across executive and corporate channels, with a particular focus on LinkedIn and other platforms where technical buyers, partners, investors, customers, and industry influencers spend time.

You will develop the strategy, write the content, shape the voice, test formats, track performance, and build a social engine that is sharp, intelligent, and distinctive. This includes company posts, executive posts, technical POVs, event coverage, launch support, partner amplification, customer moments, recruiting content, and timely commentary on industry developments.

Executive Voice & Thought Leadership

You will help build and sharpen the public voices of the company’s executives and technical leaders. That means developing points of view, ghostwriting posts, preparing talking points, identifying timely angles, and turning internal conviction into external narrative.

Technical Communications

You will work closely with product marketing, product, engineering, infrastructure, sales, partnerships and leadership to understand what the company is building and why it matters.

You will translate technical topics into clear, compelling communications for the market. This may include short-form social content, executive posts, speaking abstracts, event messaging, award submissions, customer stories, and thought-leadership themes.

You should know how to ask good questions, pressure-test claims, avoid hype, and make technical content accessible without making it shallow.

Speaking, Awards & Opportunity Pipeline

You will build and manage a proactive speaking and visibility engine for the company and its executives.

We expect a consistent weekly motion: sourcing opportunities, drafting abstracts, preparing submissions, pitching panels, finding podcasts, tracking deadlines, managing speaker assets, and creating a calendar of external visibility opportunities.

The expectation is not that every submission turns into a talk. The expectation is that the opportunity pipeline is always moving.

Tools, Analytics & Leverage

You should be fluent with modern marketing, social, research, writing, analytics, AI, design, video, transcript, and workflow tools. We are looking for someone who uses tools to move faster, test more ideas, repurpose better, and increase output quality without adding process drag. You should be comfortable measuring what works, identifying patterns, and improving the system over time.

Who You Are

You have 7–10+ years of experience in B2B technology communications, social media, content, executive communications, PR, thought leadership, or a closely related function.

You have worked in technical markets and can show that you understand how to communicate complex products, platforms, or infrastructure to sophisticated audiences.

You are an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment.

You are social-native, not social-adjacent. You understand hooks, formats, timing, voice, audience behavior, and what makes technical content travel.

You are deeply resourceful. You do not wait to be handed opportunities. You find them, qualify them, pursue them, and keep the machine moving.

You are creative with language, formats, and tools.

You are commercially aware. You understand that social and communications should support brand, category creation, executive visibility, partner credibility, recruiting, customer confidence, and pipeline influence.

You are highly autonomous. You need direction, context, and access - not constant supervision.

Ideal Background

The strongest candidates may come from high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, developer tools, data infrastructure, enterprise software, telecom, semiconductors, or technical agencies with deep B2B experience.

Agency experience can be valuable if you have been hands-on with technical storytelling and executive communications. Big-company experience can be valuable if you have also operated with startup speed and ownership.

What matters most is quality of output, technical curiosity, taste, velocity, and judgment.

  • This is not a maintenance role.

  • This is not a role for someone who only manages calendars, routes approvals, or posts pre-written updates.

  • This is not a traditional PR role or media relations role.

  • This is not a generic social media role focused on lightweight engagement.

  • We are looking for someone who can build a communications engine around a complex technical company - someone who can find the story, sharpen the point of view, create the content, and push the company into the right conversations.

Why should you join us?

 

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

  • 25 days of annual leave

What success looks like in year one

  • Partners and Functional Leaders visibly more confident and skilled at developing their people, not just assessing them

  • People growing faster and more deliberately, with real development evidence behind every promotion case, not last-minute case-building

  • Every new joiner on a genuine development runway from day one, not just surviving probation

  • A live, skills-based framework that people can see their own growth against

  • Senior experience in people development, performance coaching or L&D, ideally somewhere with a strong, explicit growth philosophy rather than a generic annual-review cycle

About the role

Lendable's Payments team transacts money for our UK Loans, AutoLend (motor finance) and Zable (credit card) products: disbursing loans, collecting repayments, refunding customers and reconciling everything against our banking providers.

We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated.

This is a hands-on operational role and a strong first job in fintech. You don't need finance experience; we'll teach you the payments side. You do need to be numerate, methodical, quick to learn and comfortable being the last line of defence before money leaves the building.

What you'll do

Daily funding controls (core responsibility)

  • Run the daily pre-release checks on partner funding: gather payment evidence from our third-party partners, reconcile it to our disbursal records, and confirm that yesterday's funds reached the intended recipients before today's payments are approved.

  • Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it.

  • Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit.

  • Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early.

  • Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them.

  • Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions.

Payments and finance operations

  • Support day-to-day payment operations: cash allocation of incoming repayments, refunds and returned payments, and reconciliation against our bank and payment providers.

  • Prepare and check payment files for approval, for example, bulk payment files for customer refunds and complaint redress.

  • Pick up Finance Help Desk tickets from other teams: payment traces, refund and redress requests, "has this payment arrived" queries.

 

Partner indemnity recovery

  • Support the colleague who leads our partner indemnity recovery process. Where an agreement is cancelled, unwound or found to have been mis-sold, our partner agreements entitle us to recover amounts from the partner. You'll help validate each case against our records: confirming the agreement status, the amounts paid out and received, and what is contractually recoverable.

  • Prepare and reconcile the recovery figures that go to partners, track invoices raised against amounts received, and chase and resolve queries and shortfalls.

  • Support the unwind process on cancelled agreements: making sure customer refunds, partner recoveries and internal ledger entries all tie back to the same numbers.

  • Help bring the recovery backlog under control and keep an accurate, up-to-date view of what is outstanding by partner.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • A degree (2:1 or above, or equivalent) in a STEM, finance, accounting, economics or other quantitative subject, completed within the last two years.

  • Strong numeracy and comfort working with large volumes of transactional data.

  • Strong attention to detail and healthy scepticism. You can quickly identify when supporting documentation, such as a bank statement, does not fully evidence what it is intended to.

  • Confident with Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, filters and tidy, checkable working.

  • Clear written communication. You can explain to a non-finance colleague why a payment has been held.

  • Confident dealing with external partners: obtaining documentation promptly and professionally, and politely pushing back where it is incomplete.

  • Comfortable handling sensitive customer, partner and payment data responsibly.

Nice to have

  • Some exposure to Python, SQL or a similar language from your degree, a project or self-study, and an appetite to use it to automate repetitive work. We use Snowflake.

  • An internship, placement or project involving finance, operations or messy real-world data.

  • An interest in payments, lending or how money moves between businesses.

What success looks like at 6 months

  • The daily funding control runs reliably across the agreed partner population with a full evidence trail, and no payment is released without the previous day's funds being evidenced.

  • Exceptions and emerging trends are flagged early, documented and resolved with the right teams.

  • Partner and payee bank details have been verified on the agreed cycle.

  • The partner indemnity recovery backlog has been validated, invoiced where due and is tracked in one accurate, up-to-date view.

  • The funding control is documented end-to-end and materially more automated than when you started.

jobs.title: Product Manager - UPL
jobs.description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The team 

Unsecured Personal Loans is one of Zopa’s largest and most established products, sitting at the heart of the bank’s growth ambitions. As a Product Manager in UPL Growth, you will own a meaningful part of how we originate loans: the decisioning, data and product journeys that determine who we can lend to, how confidently we can make an offer, and how simply customers can access one. 

This is far more than keeping a mature product moving. You will have the space to identify the biggest opportunities to improve conversion, eligibility and growth, then take them from a commercial hypothesis through discovery and delivery into measurable results. That might mean rethinking how we use third-party data, improving a partner journey, or changing the rules and logic behind our lending decisions. 

You will work in a small, ambitious product team alongside three flexible backend engineering teams, with close partnership from Credit Risk, Data Science and First Line Risk. The work is complex, fast-moving and consequential: the decisions you shape will directly influence customer outcomes and the scale of Zopa’s lending business.

The work sits closer to commercial and analytical reasoning than to customer discovery — you will spend as much time interrogating data, sizing opportunities and shaping decisioning logic as you will running user research. If that sounds like the kind of PM work you are drawn to, this role is built for you. 


A day in the life

  • Own a defined area of the UPL growth roadmap, from opportunity sizing through to launch, measurement and iteration. 

  • Turn commercial and customer signals into a clear product strategy, choosing where to focus and what not to pursue. 

  • Shape the origination and decisioning experience, including the rules, journeys and data that sit behind a customer receiving a loan offer. 

  • Lead cross-functional discovery with Engineering, Credit Risk and Data Science to find the most valuable, feasible route to growth. 

  • Develop propositions that give customers greater clarity and confidence before they invest time in a full application. 

  • Make the call on scope and sequencing, balancing customer value, risk, commercial return and engineering effort. 

  • Use data to uncover friction, validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of your work. 

  • Bring new growth ideas into the roadmap, from smarter use of existing data to new external data sources and partner opportunities. 

  • Translate complex lending and technical problems into decisions that senior stakeholders can align behind. 

  • Build, launch and continually improve products that help Zopa move closer to becoming the UK’s leading unsecured lender. 


About you

  • You are analytically strong and comfortable using data to find non-obvious product insight. 

  • You have made product decisions that delivered measurable commercial outcomes. 

  • You can partner closely with engineers through scope and timeline trade-offs. 

  • You approach ambiguous problems with sound judgement and a bias for practical progress. 

  • You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders across technical and risk-focused teams. 

  • You are motivated by growth, efficiency and business impact. 

 

 


Added bonus
  • Experience in lending, consumer credit or related financial products. 

    • Familiarity with originations, underwriting, pricing or servicing. 

    • A quantitative foundation through study or equivalent experience. 

    • Experience in a fast-paced, data-led fintech environment. 

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

     

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

     

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

jobs.description:

Team

To do this effectively and at scale we use the modern digital technologies including Azure, Fabric, Power BI and Python. We pride ourselves on being structured and outcome driven, helping us to build the best solutions and helping us to continuously improve what we do.

  1. Solve our clients’ most complex business problems: Develop data-driven digital solutions tailored to clients' needs by fully understanding their business processes and challenging the status quo.

  4. Productisation of client solutions: Work with our technical teams to develop products that work across different clients.
  5. Following and developing our processes: Following our best practices and identifying areas for us to improve by refining or introducing new processes.
 
Your Capabilities
As a candidate, you should have: 
  • Degree educated in one of the following: Engineering, Surveying, Project Management, or similar.
  • 5+ years experience in the engineering/construction of large capital projects (>USD 100m).
  • 2+ years experience driving data and digital solutions set up and implementation across an organisation or large project.
  • Great communication skills, able to translate complex ideas in a clear and concise manner to a wide variety of audiences.

  • Have an analytical mindset and be able to create structure and clarity from uncertainty. 
 
It would also be great if you have: 
  • Chartered in relevant body (e.g. ICE, RICS) or moving towards chartership.
  • PMP/APM membership and/or MBA.
  • Consultancy experience.
  • Working knowledge of information management best practice.
  • Product Management/Software development experience.
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI).
  • Experience with databases (e.g. SQL, Azure)

  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Benefits 
 
The standard stuff:  
- Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority  
- Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings  
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance  
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The life-changing stuff:

- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it 
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins 
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up 
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Important! Applying properly
 
We get hundreds of applications so please ensure your CV one or two pages. You will also be asked the following questions: 
  • What new opportunities or experiences are you seeking in this role that your current position hasn’t provided?

We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, ideally six figures or more, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

jobs.title: Leitung Vertriebsinnendienst und Prozesssteuerung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Worms · Vollzeit · unbefristet · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung
Berichtet direkt an: Head of Sales
Führt: Vertriebsinnendienst und Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling

Bei NICO entstehen gute Ergebnisse, wenn Menschen, Prozesse und Informationen zuverlässig zusammenspielen: Kalkulationen müssen stimmen, Angebote sorgfältig vorbereitet, Aufgaben klar verteilt und Entscheidungen durch belastbare Zahlen unterstützt werden.

Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die den Überblick behält, Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Menschen gute Lösungen entwickelt. Sie schaffen so viel Struktur wie nötig und halten Abläufe so einfach wie möglich.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle: Sie führen den Vertriebsinnendienst sowie die Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling fachlich und disziplinarisch. Dabei verantworten Sie die Organisation und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Vertriebsprozesse. Klassische Kundenbetreuung steht nicht im Mittelpunkt dieser Position.

Sie koordinieren den Gesamtprozess – von Kalkulation und Angebot über Auftrag, Beschaffung und Lieferung bis zu Rechnung, Auswertung und Nachbereitung. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Zuständigkeiten geklärt sind, Informationen fließen und Entscheidungen auf verlässlichen Daten beruhen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Sie führen Ihr Team klar, wertschätzend und nah am Arbeitsalltag.
  • Sie steuern und verbessern die internen Vertriebsprozesse über alle Prozessschritte hinweg.
  • Sie koordinieren insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Buchhaltung und Logistik und beziehen IT sowie weitere beteiligte Bereiche rechtzeitig ein.
  • Sie klären Zuständigkeiten, Übergaben, Freigaben und Vertretungen und verfolgen Vereinbarungen verbindlich nach.
  • Sie erkennen Informationslücken, unnötige Arbeitsschritte und wiederkehrende Fehlerquellen und entwickeln mit den Beteiligten praktikable Lösungen.
  • Sie erstellen und pflegen verständliche Prozessbeschreibungen, Arbeitsanweisungen, Handbücher, Checklisten und Vorlagen.
  • Gemeinsam mit der IT verbessern Sie digitale Ablagen, Ordnerstrukturen, Berechtigungen und die Nutzung vorhandener Systeme.
  • Sie setzen digitale Werkzeuge zur Arbeits- und Projektorganisation ein, um Aufgaben, Termine, Ziele und Verantwortlichkeiten transparent zu machen.
  • Zusammen mit dem Vertriebscontrolling sorgen Sie für aussagekräftige Kennzahlen, nachvollziehbare Auswertungen und eine verlässliche Datengrundlage.
  • Sie prüfen Zahlen auf Plausibilität, erkennen Abweichungen und Zusammenhänge und leiten daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Sie bereiten Informationen für den Head of Sales verständlich auf und geben einen realistischen Überblick über laufende Themen, Entwicklungen und mögliche Engpässe.
  • Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig zusammenkommt, setzen Sie klare Prioritäten und geben Ihrem Team Orientierung.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen:

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir keine reine Verwaltungskraft, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Prozess-, Zahlen- und Datenverständnis.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst, in der Vertriebsorganisation, im Vertriebscontrolling oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion
  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für kaufmännische Gesamtprozesse – von Kalkulation und Angebot bis zu Lieferung, Rechnung und Auswertung
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der bereichsübergreifenden Prozesskoordination
  • Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Auswertungen kritisch zu prüfen und verständlich einzuordnen
  • Erfahrung in der Dokumentation, Vereinheitlichung und Verbesserung von Abläufen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP- beziehungsweise Warenwirtschaftssystemen und den gängigen Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität sowie nachvollziehbare Ablage- und Informationsstrukturen
  • Offenheit für digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo diese Abläufe vereinfachen und die Qualität der Arbeit verbessern können
  • Eine verbindliche Kommunikation, ein respektvoller Führungsstil und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind hilfreich

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten möchten

Wir wünschen uns eine Führungskraft, die zuhört, nachfragt und die Erfahrung ihres Teams einbezieht. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Sie Entscheidungen treffen, Prioritäten setzen und vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent umsetzen.

Agile Zusammenarbeit bedeutet für uns ganz praktisch: Aufgaben sichtbar machen, Verantwortlichkeiten klären, sich regelmäßig abstimmen und Verbesserungen Schritt für Schritt umsetzen.

Zahlen verstehen wir dabei nicht als Selbstzweck. Sie sollen Entwicklungen sichtbar machen, Ursachen erkennen lassen und bessere Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

Was Sie bei der NICO erwartet

Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit direkter Anbindung an den Head of Sales und spürbarem Einfluss auf die Zusammenarbeit im Unternehmen.

Sie treffen auf erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, bestehende Strukturen und den gemeinsamen Wunsch, Abläufe transparenter, einfacher und verlässlicher zu gestalten. Dabei sollen Sie nicht vom ersten Tag an fertige Antworten liefern. Uns ist wichtig, dass Sie zunächst verstehen, dann bewerten und anschließend gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten die richtigen Veränderungen umsetzen.

Wir bieten Ihnen eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle an unserem Standort in Worms, eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, kurze Abstimmungswege und eine der Verantwortung angemessene Vergütung.

Benefits

Warum Sie bei uns gut aufgehoben sind:

  • Ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit 10 Personen am Standort Worms, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt
  • Ein Familienunternehmen, das Stabilität, Bodenständigkeit und kurze Entscheidungswege vereint
  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel, faire Vergütung und ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – besonders im Bereich Prozesse
  • Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag in einer spannenden und dynamischen Branche
  • flexible Arbeitszeiten, modernes Zeiterfassungs/Abwesenheitssytem, regelmäßige Teammeetings und Firmenevents
  • monatliche Sachbezüge als Gutschein, die Ihnen nach der Probezeit zusätzliche Vorteile im Alltag bieten

Wir möchten Sie kennenlernen

Uns interessiert nicht nur Ihr Lebenslauf. Erzählen Sie uns auch, wie Sie führen, welche Prozesse Sie bereits verbessert haben und wie Sie Zahlen und Daten für gute Entscheidungen nutzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

NICO Feuerwerk GmbH
Am Guten Brunnen 10
67547 Worms

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Hohe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (Coaching, Academy, interne Trainings)

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Unternehmens

Deine Aufgaben

jobs.title: Senior software engineer - 6 month O/IR35
jobs.description:
This role is remote within the UK, and we're looking for engineers available quickly to join us for 6 months under O/IR35 requirements.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

 
 

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

 

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

 

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

 

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

 

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

  • Make decisions quickly, solve problems directly and own execution from idea to results

  • Experience owning P&L, revenue, growth or other measurable business outcomes

  • Strong product and commercial judgement

  • Ability to work across product, engineering, operations and commercial functions

  • Experience building and leading strong teams

  • Hands-on approach - comfortable moving between strategy and detailed execution

  • Strong ownership, speed and ability to operate with limited structure
