jobs.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale. Working closely with Protect (our second line) and across all operations functions, you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance support looks like here, keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The Service Guild at Griffin is the mindful engine room, driving our success. We strive to bring joy to our customers, both internal and external, through systems that just work.

There are four core elements to operations at Griffin: fincrime, payments, treasury ops and operational resilience. Across all teams, we place significant emphasis on compassion, ownership and curiosity. You will be empowered to make meaningful decisions and supported to make sure we collectively get those decisions right.

The opportunity

We want compliance built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

What success looks like

In your first year, our operations, sales and product teams bring you in early by default, because working with you makes things smoother, not slower. You've guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. Our live products have clear governance and outcome monitoring, and Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation in place.

To do this you'll be involved in:

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments from first idea through product approval to launch.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on both our marketing materials and ensuring that our customer's marketing materials are compliant with regulation and our own internal policies. Also ensuring that our own financial promotions are compliant and challenged appropriately.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations.

  • A hands on approach. You've turned regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams, and you're comfortable interpreting and applying FCA rules to new situations.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn't right.

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have worked in finance or Banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph / On-Prem Cloud Storage (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your Role

You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, experienced team, you will own the Ceph clusters behind our block, object and file storage services – essentially the storage every customer workload eventually lands on. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes

Unser Tech Stack 🚀

· Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium
· RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance.

  • Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact.

  • Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal, working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity.

  • Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes.

  • Own capacity planning and growth forecasting, use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security.

  • AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling, document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team.

What we offer

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production.

  • You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load.

  • You have managed storage infrastructure end to end, from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations.

  • You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane, not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed.

  • You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way.

  • You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills, understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations.

  • Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi, deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership, and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave.

  • We work in an international environment in English, so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English.

jobs.title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.  

  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. 

Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀 

Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die IT Landschaft und die Möglichkeiten, die du in dieser Rolle hast.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (m/f/d) part time | ideal alongside your studies
jobs.description:
Would you like to maintain more than just another technical system and work with a technology that is truly unique worldwide? ⚡

Our client is a fast growing GreenTech startup developing one of the world’s first scalable road based power plants. The technology uses existing road infrastructure to generate renewable energy from passing traffic without requiring any additional land.

As a Maintenance Technician in Hamburg, you will be responsible for the technical operation and maintenance of the road based power plant installed there. You will ensure reliable operation, carry out maintenance and repairs, and systematically investigate technical faults.

You will not simply follow existing procedures. Since this is an entirely new technology, you will actively help shape how maintenance, service, and technical support processes are developed for the future. Your hands on experience from daily operations will directly contribute to the continued development of the service structure.

Your Benefits

• Unique technology: Work with the world’s first road based power plant in active operation and contribute to a GreenTech solution that currently exists nowhere else in this form.

• Real opportunity to shape processes: Develop maintenance schedules, service processes, and maintenance structures together with the team instead of simply following existing procedures.

• Flexible part time schedule: Work 20 to 30 hours per week with flexible working hours that can easily be combined with university studies or other commitments.

• Independent work: Take responsibility for the technical operation of the plant in Hamburg and enjoy a high degree of autonomy when it comes to maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs.

• Development opportunities: Grow together with the technology and take on additional responsibility for operations and service as your experience increases.

• Attractive compensation: Receive competitive compensation based on your qualifications and practical experience.

Your Responsibilities

As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the reliable technical operation of the road based power plant in Hamburg.

• Maintenance and repairs: Inspect and maintain the system across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components. Your responsibilities will also include tasks such as monitoring and maintaining the hydraulic oil.

• Troubleshooting: Analyse technical issues, resolve faults, and document both the solution and the underlying cause.

• Service development: Create and continuously improve maintenance schedules, spare parts lists, and technical service documentation for the system.

• Spare parts management: Keep track of spare parts stored on site and ensure they are managed in a structured and reliable way.

Your Profile as a Maintenance Technician

• You have a technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology, or a comparable technical qualification.

• You have practical experience in the mechanical maintenance and repair of technical systems or machinery.

• You have a solid understanding of hydraulic systems and are able to independently understand technical relationships and identify potential issues.

• You are available for 20 to 30 hours per week and are flexible enough to occasionally work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when suitable maintenance windows are available at the terminal.

• You enjoy taking responsibility, work independently, and remain calm and solution oriented when dealing with technical problems.

• You enjoy working directly on technical equipment and outdoors and feel comfortable in an active traffic and logistics environment.

• The ability to confidently read technical drawings, hydraulic schematics, and electrical circuit diagrams is an advantage.

Would you like to do more than simply maintain a globally unique GreenTech system and actively help shape how its future operation and service structure are developed? ⚡

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, we're Dana and Erik, the founders of Circonomit. We build the decision platform industrial companies use to plan their production.

Dana sees the customer side. She needs to know which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim.

Erik sees the engineering side. He needs requirements that are ready to be built, complete, and clear about what we deliberately leave out.

The product sits between the two, and that is this role. We sell vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt. You decide what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.

How you will be measured: how much of today's project work is standard product a year from now, and how quickly a recognised customer problem becomes a usable capability.

We came out of RWTH research, raised €2.8M with Vorwerk Ventures, and have customers running on our models today. Small team, Cologne office.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. You have owned a product area end to end, not only a backlog.
  • A technical and analytical foundation: engineering, data, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling.
  • You recognise when a requirement creates technical debt or will not be reusable at the next customer. You will not write production code.
  • Experience deciding under incomplete information, and explaining the trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
  • You are comfortable working directly with plant managers and controllers, and understand how they decide today.
  • German at C1 level or above, and fluent English. Customer conversations happen in German.
  • Existing work visa for Germany.

You should enjoy being in front of customers in your first week, and deciding without a research team behind you. Priorities change as we learn from customers, and we make scope and trade-offs explicit together.

Benefits

  • Ownership. The roadmap, and where the line between product and customer project sits.
  • Shaping the role. This is the founding product role. You define how product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.
  • Exposure. You present your roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, and you sit in the core strategy conversations.
  • Real-world impact. Customers plan their production on our models today.
  • Direct collaboration. Small team, no org chart. We work directly together. Weekly feedback, both ways.
  • Compensation. Competitive salary plus a VSOP package reflecting your contribution and development in the role.
  • Hybrid work. Our HQ is in Cologne, and we meet there regularly.
  • Your setup and everyday extras. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: An intro call, a second conversation with the team, a 60- to 90-minute live case on a real customer requirement, then in-person conversations with the team.

"Hustle the day, analyse at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

L’un des atouts majeurs de Pennylane aujourd’hui est son réseau de partenaires revendeurs.

Le Partner marketing specialist a un rôle essentiel dans le développement de notre écosystème partenaires en pilotant notre stratégie marketing via nos partenaires revendeurs (intégrateurs). Il a pour objectif de générer des leads qualifiés et de renforcer notre position de leader dans la gestion financière.
En collaboration étroite avec notre équipe partenariat et les partner account managers, ce rôle implique la conception et le déploiement de campagnes de co-marketing innovantes. L'objectif est de créer des synergies durables qui alimentent notre croissance tout en maximisant la visibilité de notre proposition de valeur unique.
Le succès de cette mission repose sur une approche méthodique combinant la génération d'opportunités commerciales, le développement de relations partenaires privilégiées et l'exécution de campagnes marketing à fort impact mesurable.

Missions

  • Gérer les relations avec les équipes marketing des partenaires, en assurant une communication efficace et en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités de collaboration.

  • Élaborer et gérer des campagnes de co-marketing, y compris des webinaires, des événements, des contenus partagés, etc.

  • Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes pour optimiser les stratégies et assurer un retour sur investissement positif.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes (partenariats, marketing, sales, product marketing) pour aligner les initiatives marketing avec les objectifs commerciaux de Pennylane.

  • Former et accompagner les partenaires sur les supports marketing disponibles

  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Communication

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Scale up Healthtech
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public

L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executives qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire.

Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille. Leur potentiel est réel, mais le CRM est encore peu qualifié et les bons interlocuteurs restent souvent à identifier.

Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Cartographier et prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé, en partant d’une base CRM encore largement à enrichir.

  • Identifier les bons interlocuteurs au sein de ces établissements, en mobilisant les informations disponibles sur Internet, LinkedIn, le téléphone et les autres canaux de prospection.

  • Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive.

  • Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace.

  • Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes.

  • Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une première expérience commerciale (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client.

  • Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié.

  • La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM.

  • Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé.

  • Une première expérience dans un environnement startup ou scale-up.

  • La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection.

Soft skills

Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Face à une base peu qualifiée, tu sais chercher, trier l’information et décider par où commencer, sans te disperser. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity. Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées.

Bienveillance. Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien.

Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio.

  1. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale.

  2. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de trois exercices : deux préparés à l’avance et un exercice réalisé en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h30 à 2h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à qualifier un compte, à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté.

  3. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel.

Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord.

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique.

jobs.title: Growth Manager (m/w/d)

2. Produktportfolio (Core Focus)

  • Recherche neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Zielsegmente sowie Validierung erster Hypothesen

3. Kommunikation & Go-to-Market (Outreach)

  • Du hilfst dabei, unser Portfolio klar zu kommunizieren – Website / Landing Pages, Sales Decks und Angebotsstrukturen
  • Aufbau einer konsistenten Story: „Was machen wir?“, „Für wen?“, „Warum wir?“

5. Data & Performance

  • Aufbau und Pflege eines einfachen, klaren KPI-Reportings für Pipeline, Conversion Rates, Deal Size / ACV und weitere relevante Kennzahlen

Qualifikation

Wir suchen bewusst keine fertige Persönlichkeit auf Head-Level. jobs.description:
Seit über 15 Jahren begleite ich gemeinsam mit meinem Team Fach- und Führungskräfte in der Personaldienstleistung bei ihrer beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.

Sie kennen die Personaldienstleistung, beherrschen die Personaldisposition und arbeiten gerne mit jungen Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Ländern? In dieser vielseitigen Position verbinden Sie die operative Einsatzplanung in der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit der persönlichen und organisatorischen Betreuung internationaler Studierender.

Unser Mandant ist ein mittelständisches, wirtschaftlich sehr starkes und bundesweit erfolgreich agierendes Unternehmen der Personaldienstleistung. Im Zuge der weiteren Expansion baut das Unternehmen die Arbeitnehmerüberlassung internationaler Studierender weiter aus. Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Personaldisponent (m/w/d), der die vollständige Disposition, Einsatzplanung und Betreuung der Studierenden übernimmt und die Zusammenarbeit mit den Kundenunternehmen zuverlässig koordiniert.

Die Position kann wahlweise von der Niederlassung in Köln, der Niederlassung in Karlsruhe oder aus dem Homeoffice ausgeübt werden.

Aufgaben

  • Sie übernehmen die vollständige Betreuung und Disposition der internationalen Studierenden während ihres gesamten Aufenthaltes und ihrer Beschäftigung in Deutschland.

  • Sie begleiten das gesamte Onboarding und stehen den Studierenden während ihrer Einsätze bei persönlichen, organisatorischen und arbeitsbezogenen Fragen zur Seite.
  • Sie erfassen Arbeits- und Fehlzeiten, pflegen die Personalstammdaten und übernehmen die mit der Betreuung und Disposition verbundenen administrativen Aufgaben.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in der Personaldienstleistung und der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit.
  • Sie verfügen über praktische Erfahrung in der Personaldisposition, Einsatzplanung und Betreuung von Mitarbeitenden.
  • Idealerweise haben Sie bereits internationale Mitarbeitende oder Studierende betreut.
  • Sie verfügen zwingend über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und können auch komplexere Inhalte sicher und verständlich vermitteln.
  • Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Sie zeichnen sich durch ein hohes Maß an Selbstorganisation, Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit aus und steuern Ihre Aufgaben auch aus dem Homeoffice zuverlässig.
  • Sie behalten bei mehreren parallelen Einsätzen, wechselnden Anforderungen und kurzfristigen Veränderungen den Überblick.
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und serviceorientiert und besitzen ein gutes Gespür für Menschen.
  • Sie begegnen jungen Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Ländern und Kulturen offen, wertschätzend und verbindlich.
  • Sie bringen die notwendige zeitliche Flexibilität mit, um die Studierenden bei Bedarf auch außerhalb der üblichen Bürozeiten am Flughafen abzuholen oder persönlich zu unterstützen.
  • Sie besitzen einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringen große Freude an einer Reisebereitschaft mit

Benefits

  • Umfangreiche Einarbeitung
  • Homeoffice – Möglichkeit
  • Attraktives Fixgehalt
  • Firmenwagen mit privater Nutzung
  • Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen durch Corporate Benefits

jobs.title: Account Executive - [UK&I]
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our founding sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta:

  • Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities.

  • Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes.

  • Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals.

  • Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value.

  • Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices.

  • Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter.

  • Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets.

  • Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 3+ years closing experience

  • Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

  • Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

  • Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them

  • Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

  • Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

  • Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

jobs.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As one of Harvey’s founding SMB Account Executives, you'll play a pivotal role in driving growth within the legal and professional services markets. You will be responsible for establishing new business relationships with small law firms and in-house legal teams, deeply understanding their challenges, and delivering AI solutions that transform how they work. By combining a high-velocity sales motion with a consultative, solution-driven approach, you’ll set the foundation for how we win in SMB and create long term impact for our clients. We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments, is energized by building from scratch, and is passionate about bringing Harvey’s mission to life.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own your book of business by prioritizing warm leads and a named account list to maintain a high velocity sales motion.

  • Manage the new business lifecycle from prospecting to qualifying, validating Harvey’s solution, and contracting.

  • Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.

  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.

  • Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations.

  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet SMB customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.

  • Proactively develop tactics, collateral, and messaging to improve the SMB team’s performance, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.

 

What You Have

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; written and spoken

  • Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology at high velocity.

  • Capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish

  • Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene

  • Ability to lead a multi-threaded sale with executive stakeholders – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

  • Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.

  • Energized by contributing to the development of our team, sales processes, and culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.

jobs.title: General Manager, Trainline Media
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Media Team 👋

Trainline Media is an emerging part of Trainline's strategy, with real momentum behind it. The team brings together sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, and is moving from an early pilot into its next phase of growth. It sits within a business where advertising is one part of a broader, operationally focused whole. This role suits someone who enjoys building: shaping team culture, defining how the function works and making thoughtful, steady progress.

As General Manager, Trainline Media, you will work closely with colleagues across the business, taking the time to understand how Trainline operates and aligning change with its wider priorities. In your first six to twelve months, you will help sharpen how Trainline Media presents itself to the market, focus the team on the right priorities and put in place the operational foundations needed to grow, balancing commercial growth with operational effectiveness.

In this role as the General Manager, Trainline Media, you will...🚄

  • Set the direction for Trainline Media, shaping its proposition, target market and growth priorities so it becomes a trusted travel media offering.

  • Take ownership of Trainline Media's revenue targets, working with senior stakeholders to align its goals with wider business priorities.

  • Partner with colleagues across Product, Data, PR and Marketing to develop the proposition and bring it to market.

  • Represent Trainline Media externally, building awareness and credibility with the media and advertising buying community through an active industry presence.

  • Lead and grow a team of more than ten people across sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, creating a culture where people want to join and develop.

  • Design the operating model, processes and measures needed to scale the business, including client delivery and billing, using data and AI tools to help the team work smarter.

  • Balance commercial growth with operational effectiveness, so the function delivers sustainably as it grows.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Experience building and scaling a media or advertising function, ideally within a larger, operationally focused consumer technology business.

  • A solid understanding of brand media, with the ability to position and grow an emerging proposition. Experience across performance media is also helpful if you have it.

  • Experience leading and growing large teams, and creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Experience owning revenue targets and designing the processes, operating rhythms and measures that support sustainable, scalable growth.

  • Sound judgement in balancing competing priorities, working constructively in a business where advertising is one of several revenue streams, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities and practical action.

  • A collaborative, diplomatic leadership style, with the ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Curiosity about how data and AI tools can improve the way a team works, and ideally some experience putting them to use.

  • An active presence in the media industry, or a keen interest in building one, and the confidence to represent the business externally.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

This is a highly visible team, also providing dedicated AV/VC support for meeting rooms and internal events — ensuring high availability, instilling trust, and enabling a seamless experience for Executive-level presenters.

About the Role

This is not just a senior technical position — it is a leadership role within the team. We are looking for someone who takes genuine ownership: of problems, of standards, of team capability, and of the overall service we deliver to Trainliners. You will be the go-to person when things get complex, the one who sets the bar for quality, and the one who actively lifts others to reach it.

You will work closely with the Workplace Technology Lead, acting as a technical anchor for the team — driving consistency, mentoring your peers, championing best practices, and making sure nothing important falls through the cracks. If you see something that isn't right, you fix it. If a junior engineer is stuck, you help them through it. If a process is broken, you own improving it.

As a Senior IT Support Analyst, you'll be responsible for... 🚝

Technical Leadership & Team Ownership

• Acting as the technical escalation point for the team — owning complex incidents end-to-end and ensuring nothing stalls without clear direction

• Mentoring and upskilling junior and mid-level engineers: pairing on problems, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge deliberately and consistently

• Setting and maintaining quality standards for ticket management, documentation, and technical investigations across the team

• Driving team readiness — identifying skill gaps, flagging them to the Lead, and taking initiative to close them through coaching or knowledge sessions

• Leading by example in attitude, thoroughness, communication, and follow-through — shaping the team culture through daily behaviour

• Supporting the Workplace Technology Lead with operational decisions, workload balancing, and service improvements

Incident, Problem & Request Management

• Owning the full incident lifecycle for complex and high-priority issues — from triage and investigation through to resolution and post-incident review

• Conducting deep root cause analysis: reviewing logs, correlating cross-system patterns, engaging third-party vendors, and documenting findings clearly

• Ensuring the team's ticket queue is healthy — proactively monitoring dashboards, reassigning where needed, and preventing SLA breaches before they happen

• Driving problem management: identifying recurring incidents, initiating investigations, and leading permanent fix efforts rather than accepting repeat workarounds

• Owning escalation quality — ensuring issues are fully investigated, clearly documented, and appropriately packaged before being escalated to Tier 3 or vendors

Microsoft 365, Azure AD & Identity Management

• Azure Active Directory: user and group lifecycle, Conditional Access policy design and troubleshooting, SSPR, MFA enforcement, and RBAC

100 % remote · Teilzeit möglich · Unbezahltes Praktikum · Start nach Absprache

Die Jacke, die du ständig trägst. Das Secondhand-Teil, für das dir noch eine Kombination fehlt. Ein Blick in einen anderen Kleiderschrank – und plötzlich eine Idee für deinen eigenen.

Your wardrobe has more in it.

Ich bin Christopher, Gründer von Try It. Ich entwickle eine App, mit der du deine Kleidung erfassen, Outfits zusammenstellen und neue Möglichkeiten in deiner eigenen Garderobe entdecken kannst. Was du davon trägst, entscheidest du.

Jetzt suche ich jemanden, der Lust hat, Try It mit mir sichtbar zu machen und eine Community mit aufzubauen. Du bringst deinen Blick auf Mode und Menschen mit. Ich bringe die App, die Geschichte dahinter und mich selbst ein.

Wenn du sagst: „Christopher, zeig das mal“ oder „Ich würde das anders erzählen“, bin ich dabei.

Aufgaben

Was du mitgestalten kannst

Deine Schwerpunkte vereinbaren wir passend zu deinen Erfahrungen, Lernzielen und deiner verfügbaren Zeit.

  • Eigene Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen. Ein Lieblingsteil anders kombinieren oder zeigen, was tatsächlich im Reisekoffer landet: Du erkennst solche Momente und machst daraus Reels, TikToks oder Storys. Try It wird dabei in echter Nutzung sichtbar.
  • Vor und hinter der Kamera mitwirken. Du entwickelst Formate, filmst und gestaltest Inhalte. Gerne kannst du selbst ausprobieren, erzählen und zeigen oder mich in deine Ideen einbeziehen. Deine Art und dein Humor sind willkommen.
  • Menschen zur Beteiligung einladen. Du greifst Fragen, Geschichten und Outfit-Ideen auf. Daraus können Gespräche, kleine gemeinsame Aktionen und wiederkehrende Formate entstehen.
  • Passende Creator kennenlernen. Du entdeckst Menschen mit einer interessanten Stilwelt und einer echten Verbindung zu ihrer Community. Gemeinsam bereiten wir persönliche Ansprachen vor und entwickeln bei gegenseitigem Interesse Ideen für eine Zusammenarbeit.
  • Beobachtungen zurückbringen. Was haben Menschen wiedererkannt? Was wollten sie ausprobieren? Wo blieb eine Frage offen? Deine Eindrücke helfen dabei, Inhalte und die App weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei soll Platz für unterschiedliche Menschen, Körper, Budgets und Geschmäcker entstehen. Wer seine Kleidung zeigt, erzählt seine eigene Geschichte und entscheidet selbst, was gefällt.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Du interessierst dich für Mode, persönlichen Stil und die Menschen dahinter. Du hast Lust, Try It kennenzulernen und mit deiner eigenen Garderobe auszuprobieren.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Inhalten oder Community-Arbeit sind wichtig. Vielleicht hast du einen eigenen Kanal bewusst weiterentwickelt, einen Account mitbetreut, ein kreatives Projekt umgesetzt oder Menschen rund um ein gemeinsames Interesse zusammengebracht. Auch ein kleines Projekt zählt.

Darauf kommt es mir an:

  • Sprachgefühl und kulturelles Gespür: Du drückst dich auf Deutsch klar und persönlich aus. Du verstehst die Sprache und den Humor von Communities, die dich interessieren, und merkst, wenn eine Ansprache aufgesetzt wirkt.
  • Eigeninitiative und Verlässlichkeit: Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst vereinbarte Aufgaben selbstständig und meldest dich rechtzeitig, wenn du Unterstützung brauchst.
  • Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst begründen, weshalb ein Inhalt oder ein Creator zu Try It passt, und fragst nach, wenn dir etwas unklar oder wenig glaubwürdig erscheint.
  • Neugier und Offenheit: Du möchtest dazulernen, kannst Feedback annehmen und gibst mir genauso ehrlich Rückmeldung. Auch bei Kritik bleibst du respektvoll.

Freude an der Arbeit vor der Kamera und erste Erfahrungen mit Videoschnitt oder Gestaltungstools sind willkommen. Du musst nicht alles schon beherrschen und brauchst keine große eigene Reichweite.

Benefits

Was du hier aufbauen kannst

Du arbeitest direkt mit mir als Gründer zusammen und bekommst Einblick in die Produkt- und Markenentwicklung. Zu Beginn vereinbaren wir Lernziele und einen überschaubaren Aufgabenbereich. Regelmäßiger Austausch und Feedback gehören dazu.

Gemeinsam halten wir fest, welche veröffentlichten Inhalte und Projekte du später als eigene Arbeitsbeispiele für dein Portfolio zeigen kannst.

Die Produktion soll im Alltag machbar bleiben: Smartphone, verständlicher Ton, ein echter Raum und eine gute Beobachtung können bereits reichen. Ein gelungener Moment darf einfach sein.

Rahmen und Vergütung

Du arbeitest vollständig remote. Beginn, Dauer und verlässliche Wochenstunden vereinbaren wir miteinander; Teilzeit ist möglich. Ein Pflichtpraktikum kommt ebenfalls infrage.

Das Praktikum ist unbezahlt. Es kommt deshalb nur infrage, wenn die rechtlichen Voraussetzungen für deine konkrete Praktikumsform erfüllt sind. Das klären wir vor Beginn.

Try It befindet sich im Aufbau. Ich verdiene damit aktuell selbst noch nichts und kann derzeit keine Vergütung anbieten. Das soll vor deiner Bewerbung klar sein.

Wenn es für beide Seiten passt und die wirtschaftlichen Voraussetzungen entstehen, möchte ich daraus eine bezahlte, langfristige Zusammenarbeit machen. Eine Zusage dafür kann ich heute noch nicht geben.

Lust, mitzugestalten?

Bewirb dich direkt über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf oder einem kurzen Überblick über deinen bisherigen Weg. Dazu interessieren mich drei Dinge:

  • Was spricht dich an Try It an?
  • Was hast du schon gestaltet, veröffentlicht oder mit aufgebaut? Was war dein Beitrag, und was hast du dabei gelernt?
  • Welche Community oder welchen Creator findest du spannend – und was macht den Austausch dort für dich besonders?

Vorhandene Videos, Texte oder Projektlinks schaue ich mir gerne an. Nenne bitte auch deinen möglichen Starttermin, den gewünschten Zeitraum und die Stunden, die du pro Woche verlässlich einbringen kannst.

Für die erste Bewerbung brauchst du kein neues Konzept und kein Bewerbungsvideo. Nach einem ersten Kennenlernen kann in der engeren Auswahl eine kleine Arbeitsprobe folgen: höchstens zwei Stunden Aufwand bei sieben Tagen Abgabefrist. Sie dient unserem Auswahlgespräch und wird nicht veröffentlicht oder als Content genutzt.

Ich freue mich darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Gründer von Try It
